description: RbNa₅Be₈O₁₁ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Rb is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Rb-O bond distances ranging from 2.81-2.95 Å. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.50 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.73 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.50 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.71 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.90 Å. There are eight inequivalent Be sites. In the first Be site, Be is bonded to four O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing BeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Be-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.72 Å. In the second Be site, Be is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Be-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.56 Å. In the third Be site, Be is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Be-O bond distances ranging from 1.55-1.59 Å. In the fourth Be site, Be is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Be-O bond distances ranging from 1.55-1.59 Å. In the fifth Be site, Be is bonded to four O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing BeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Be-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.67 Å. In the sixth Be site, Be is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.54 Å) and two longer (1.55 Å) Be-O bond lengths. In the seventh Be site, Be is bonded to four O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing BeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Be-O bond distances ranging from 1.64-1.69 Å. In the eighth Be site, Be is bonded to four O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing BeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Be-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.77 Å. There are eleven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Rb, two equivalent Na, and three Be atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and three Be atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Rb, three Na, and two Be atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Be atoms to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₄Be₂ octahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Rb and three Be atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Na and three Be atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to three Na and two Be atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Rb, three Na, and two Be atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Na and three Be atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Rb, two Na, and two Be atoms. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and three Be atoms.
